explain.say: Draw a circle and it looks flat, like a coin. But add light and shade, and it turns into a ball you could almost pick up! Let us try it together. Look at the first step: choose where the light comes from, say a window on the top left.

explain.say: Fantastic, your circle is now a ball! These six steps work for apples, faces and planets too. Wow fact: Italian painters called strong light and dark chiaroscuro, which means light-dark, and Caravaggio used it to make figures leap out of black backgrounds. faq.a: A highlight is the brightest spot on an object, where light hits it most directly. In pencil drawing you often leave the paper white there.
asks: Why leave white on a drawing?

faq.a: The core shadow is the darkest part on the object itself, on the side turned away from the light, just before the reflected light.
asks: What is the darkest part of a shaded ball?

faq.a: A cast shadow is the dark shape an object throws onto another surface, like the floor, because it blocks the light. It points away from the light.
asks: Which way does a shadow go?
Why is the shadow darkest under the ball?

faq.q: Why decide where the light comes from?
faq.a: Because every highlight and shadow depends on it. If the light comes from one side, the shadows must all fall on the other side, or the drawing looks wrong.
asks: Why do my shadows look wrong?
Does light direction matter in drawing?

faq.a: Chiaroscuro is an Italian word meaning light-dark. It is the use of strong contrast between light and shadow to make things look solid and dramatic, used by artists like Caravaggio and Rembrandt.

facts: Chiaroscuro comes from the Italian words chiaro, meaning light, and scuro, meaning dark.
A cast shadow always falls on the side of an object away from the light source.

quiz.say: The light shines from the left. Which way does the cast shadow fall?
quiz.show: Light from the left: the shadow falls…
quiz.why: Shadows fall on the opposite side from the light.

wrong.1: The left is lit; the shadow goes the other way.
wrong.2: Shadows fall on the surface the object sits on, away from the light.

quiz.say: What is the brightest spot on a shaded ball called?
quiz.why: The highlight is where light hits the ball most directly.

wrong.1: The core shadow is the darkest part on the ball.
wrong.2: The cast shadow lies on the table, not on the ball.
